text:
emma-partnerships: Heads up from NovaCloud — they put 25 racks (~40% of our EU reserved capacity for Q2) on a temporary hold due to customs paperwork. Shipments are now split into two ETAs: 2026-04-12 and 2026-04-26. Affects ~12 Dedicated commitments. cc @sofia-supply

sofia-supply: On it — can you paste the manifest they sent? need the serial ranges to map to customer commitments.

emma-partnerships: pasting manifest snippet from NovaCloud PDF (redacted):
```
SN: NV-93A1-0001..NV-93A1-0120
SN: NV-94B2-0001..NV-94B2-0060
Total racks: 25
Hold reason: missing CE attestation for 9 racks
```

raj-ops: We have 3 Dedicated customers with go-live in the Apr 15–20 window that will be impacted if the earlier ETA slips. Can we early-burn from marketplace inventory or shift canary allocations?

luis-sales: Which customers? Sales needs heads up. If we split customer exposures we may be able to move non-critical capacity.

emma-partnerships: Affected commitments: ACME (4/16), BitLayer (4/18), NeonHealth (4/20). ACME uses encrypted private VPC; NeonHealth is regulatory — can't do on-prem swap easily.

maya-product: If ACME can accept a partial canary (2 racks) by 4/14, we can keep their onboarding timeline. Need to check if marketplace reserved pool has that many spare racks.

sofia-supply: Marketplace pool check: `marketplace_inventory --region eu --sku nv-rack-16g` shows 6 available in DE warehouse, 10 in FR. We can allocate 2 to ACME from FR if legal ok.

luis-sales: I'll ping ACME PM now. @emma-partnerships can you draft a short note with mitigation options? I'll mark as 'do not escalate to legal yet' unless they push.

emma-partnerships: Drafting now:
> Hi ACME — short heads up: one of our partner shipments split into two deliveries; we can offer 2 racks from marketplace in FR for immediate canary, remainder arrives by 4/26. Options: (1) accept 2 racks now + rest later, (2) delay full cutover to 4/26, (3) temporary soft-capacity on hosted API. Which do you prefer? — Emma

logistics-bot: :package: NovaCloud updated manifest (v2) uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-logs/partner-manifests/nova-2026-04-02-v2.pdf

sofia-supply: Action items:
- I will confirm CE attestation ETA with NovaCloud (ETA 24h) @emma-partnerships
- Reserve 2 racks in FR marketplace for ACME (hold 48h) @raj-ops
- Prepare contingency: host some ACME workloads on hosted API route (config change) @maya-product

raj-ops: Reserved 2 FR racks for ACME. Also created canary route in staging: `route add canary-acme --model redwood-7b --capacity 2rack-fr`

luis-sales: ACME PM replied: they can accept 2-rack canary, but need written confirmation of full delivery by 4/26. I'll push that after we confirm manifest.

emma-partnerships: Thanks team. If NovaCloud doesn't produce CE attestation in 24h, we'll escalate to partner ops and swap 6 racks from marketplace (de-prioritize non-regulated customers).

sofia-supply: Noted. I'll update the ticket and loop partner-ops@redwood.
